subject: Validation run success criteria & schedule for Synthex integration
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Solis <kevin.solis@synthex.com>, Maria Chen <maria.chen@synthex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: validation run objectives and next steps

Kevin / Maria — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before kickoff.

TL;DR — We propose a 3-week validation run starting 2027-03-25 focused on three measurable success criteria (stability, latency, and accuracy on your edge-case prompts). Please confirm owners below.

Summary of what we heard from Synthex on the call:
- Primary goal: validate model serving with Synthex conversational dataset and confirm SLA-compliant latency under production-like load.
- Success is pass/fail per KPI thresholds (detailed in attachment).
- Timeline preference: short, focused run (2–4 weeks) with weekly checkpoints and a final readout.

Proposed validation plan (high level):
1) Kickoff (2027-03-25): alignment on data subset, target traffic profile, and access details (S3 creds / API allowlist).
2) Week 1 (2027-03-26 — 04-01): baseline runs + smoke tests; surface infra/config gaps.
3) Week 2 (04-02 — 04-08): full runs with KV-cache/quantization profile tuned; measure latency and throughput.
4) Week 3 (04-09 — 04-15): edge-case prompts and accuracy readouts; prepare final slide deck and recommendations.

Success criteria (proposed — details in synthex-validation-kpis.xlsx):
- Avg 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 80% of traffic segments under target concurrency.
- End-to-end request success rate >= 99.5% over 24h steady-state window.
- Accuracy: BLEU-like and intent match for flagged edge-case set >= 92% relative to your baseline.

Ownership (please confirm or propose alternates):
- Redwood technical lead: Rishi Malhotra — runtime config, batching, and telemetry.
- Redwood engagement lead: Michael Grant — overall schedule and commercial touchpoints.
- Synthex technical owner: Kevin Solis — data selection, pass/fail judgement for accuracy metrics.
- Synthex product lead: Maria Chen — business acceptance and final readout attendees.

Next steps (actionable items):
- Kevin: share a 1–2k record sample and a list of 30 edge-case prompts by EOD 2027-03-20.
- Maria: confirm who needs to attend the kickoff and whether we should include a legal/infosec observer.
- Rishi: will drop a pre-kickoff checklist and the first draft of config tweaks by 2027-03-22.

Attachments: synthex-validation-kpis.xlsx (xlsx) — KPI template and measurement plan.

If this looks good I’ll calendar the kickoff for 2027-03-25 at 10:00 PT and send the invite with a recurring weekly check-in.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Date: 2027-03-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: validation run objectives and next steps

Michael — appreciate the clear recap. This matches our expectations. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can provide the 1–2k sample by 2027-03-20; Miguel (data ops) will deliver. Expect CSV + a separate JSONL with annotations so you can replicate intent labels.
- For the "edge-case" set, we’ll include 40 prompts; Kevin to mark 30 as primary and 10 as exploratory.
- Regarding latency: we care most about 95th percentile for interactive flows (not batch scoring).

One ask: can Redwood define the concurrency profile (threads/session counts) you’ll use for the 250ms target? We need that to validate infra sizing on our side.

Also, we’d like the weekly check-ins to be 30 minutes on Thursdays at 10:00 PT if that works.

Kevin
Head of Platform Engineering | Synthex Inc
kevin.solis@synthex.com | +1 212-555-0987
